title: RAP: Radial-Angular Random Projection for Hyperbolic Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.34298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random projection is a basic compression primitive for Euclidean representation learning, with the Johnson--Lindenstrauss lemma giving a target dimension $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$ independent of the ambient dimension. As hyperbolic representations gain increasing attention in modern Transformers, vision-language models, and large language models, the same need for oblivious dimensionality reduction arises, but no analogous primitive yet exists for hyperbolic representations. We study this gap. Two natural attempts fail in dual ways: a tangent-space scheme gives a clean local guarantee but is chart-bound and pays a curvature penalty, while a fully hyperbolic projection in the hyperboloid model is geometrically native but mixes radial and angular error before feeding them into the conditioning of $\operatorname{arcosh}$. We propose radial-angular random projection (RAP), which preserves the radial coordinate exactly and applies a Euc

translated_title: RAP：面向双曲表示的径向-角向随机投影
translated_abstract: 随机投影是欧几里得表示学习中的一种基础压缩原语，Johnson–Lindenstrauss 引理给出了与环境维度无关的目标维度 $k=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log n)$。随着双曲表示在现代 Transformer、视觉-语言模型和大语言模型中日益受到关注，对这种“盲式”降维的需求也随之出现，但目前尚不存在针对双曲表示的类似原语。我们研究了这一空白。两种自然的尝试以相反的方式失败：切空间方案提供了干净的局部保证，但受制于局部坐标系且需付出曲率代价；而双曲面模型中的完全双曲投影虽然在几何上是原生的，却在将径向误差与角向误差送入 $\operatorname{arcosh}$ 的条件数之前将二者混合在一起。我们提出径向-角向随机投影（RAP），它精确地保持径向坐标，并对角向部分应用欧氏（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出径向-角向随机投影（RAP），通过精确保持径向坐标并单独处理角向误差，首次为双曲表示构建了类似 Johnson–Lindenstrauss 引理的盲式随机降维原语，填补了双曲表示学习中缺乏维度压缩工具的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Radial-Angular Random Projection (RAP), which exactly preserves the radial coordinate while separately handling angular error, providing the first Johnson–Lindenstrauss-style oblivious dimensionality reduction primitive for hyperbolic representations.
